context: A uni student meets his teacher to discuss department requirements
purpose: Teach: 教養/キャンパス/スペシャル/部会/講習/グランド/早朝/史上

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、すみません、教養課程の必修について相談したいんですが。
lines.en: Professor, sorry, I'd like to consult about the general education required courses.
lines.style: Polite student opening, slightly hesitant tone, formal academic register

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ああ、レンくん。ちょうど今、キャンパスを歩きながら考えてたところよ。
lines.en: Ah, Ren. I was just thinking about that while walking across campus.
lines.style: Warm teacher voice, casual feminine, approachable mentor tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実は、夏休みのスペシャル講習を取るか迷っていて…
lines.en: Actually, I'm torn about whether to take the special summer course...
lines.style: Thoughtful, trailing off, expressing genuine indecision politely

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先週の専門部会で、その件が話題になったのよ。受講者が史上最多らしくて。
lines.en: At last week's department committee meeting, that came up. Apparently enrollment is the highest ever.
lines.style: Informative teacher tone, sharing insider faculty information conversationally

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そんなに人気なんですか。早朝の枠もあるって聞きました。
lines.en: It's that popular? I heard there's even an early-morning slot.
lines.style: Surprised student, leaning forward with curiosity, polite register

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、六時集合よ。グランドで体を動かしてから講義室に移動するの。
lines.en: Yes, six AM gathering. You move your body on the field, then head to the lecture room.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact teacher, mildly amused at the demanding schedule

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うわ、きつそう…でも、それで単位が二つ取れるなら頑張ります。
lines.en: Whoa, sounds brutal... but if I can get two credits from it, I'll push through.
lines.style: Honest reaction followed by determined student commitment

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その意気よ。申込書、明日までに私の研究室に出しておいてね。
lines.en: That's the spirit. Submit the application to my office by tomorrow.
lines.style: Encouraging close, gentle but firm deadline reminder from mentor
